title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Sivagami invites Kanmani to a Homam for Rajasekar's recovery, but she refuses to attend. Hoping for their reunion, Sivagami urges Anbu to convince Kanmani to join the ritual.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Paraman fiercely confronts Sidharth for poisoning Ilamathi's food, but Kalamma intervenes. Later, Paraman consoles a distressed Ilamathi over the unfortunate incident.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri accepts Sandhya's terms for financial help, but she delays the payment. On the repayment deadline, Karna firmly demands that Abinaya vacate her house over the unpaid loan.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Bhagyam refuses to let Thangamayil into her house despite Gomathi and Meena's pleas. Saravanan seeks to convince Anjali and her parents to approve their marriage.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Following tense moments, Pandian brings Chandayatha and her family on time for the reception. Cheran and Chandayatha happily enjoy the celebration as their relatives gift them.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Vijaya organises a Pooja following Manoj's final divorce hearing. Lakshmi, worried about Rohini's future, confides in Vidya and shares her concerns about her life ahead.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: When Tamizhselvi arrives at the ceremony, Eshwari demands her share of the expenses. Tamizhselvi proudly hands over the money, leaving Eshwari completely speechless.

title: Super Singer Junior
description: An emotional family reunion for Saurabi and Shruthi's rocking performance elevates the Rock 'n' Roll round. Retro medleys from Super Singer stars steal the spotlight.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Endurance Under Pressure
description: Nine contestants face endurance task as Karishma Sama and Darwin battle through distractions. Who will secure the top eight positions today?
